mapper.select: select count(settlement_status) from personal_settlement where settlement_status = '정산대기'
select sum(amount) from personal_settlement where settlement_status = '정산대기'

select m.personal_match_id, m.title, m.sport, m.match_date, s.amount, s.settlement_status from personal_settlement s left join personal_match m on s.personal_match_id = m.personal_match_id order by m.match_date desc

select m.personal_match_id, m.title, m.sport, m.match_date, s.amount, s.settlement_status from personal_settlement s left join personal_match m on s.personal_match_id = m.personal_match_id where s.settlement_status = '정산대기' order by m.match_date desc

select m.personal_match_id, m.title, m.sport, m.match_date, s.amount, s.settlement_status from personal_settlement s left join personal_match m on s.personal_match_id = m.personal_match_id where s.settlement_status = '지급완료' order by match_date desc

select m.personal_match_id, m.title, m.sport, m.match_date, s.amount, s.settlement_status from personal_settlement s left join personal_match m on s.personal_match_id = m.personal_match_id where m.match_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate} order by m.match_date desc

select m.personal_match_id, m.title, m.sport, m.match_date, u.nickname, u.account_holder, u.user_id, s.settlement_id, s.bank_name, s.account_number, s.amount, s.settlement_status from personal_settlement s left join personal_match m on s.personal_match_id = m.personal_match_id left join user u on s.user_id = u.user_id where s.personal_match_id = #{personalMatchId}
select s.user_id, s.personal_match_id, m.title from personal_settlement s left join personal_match m on s.personal_match_id = m.personal_match_id where s.settlement_id = #{settlementId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO personal_settlement ( user_id, personal_match_id, account_number, bank_name, amount, settlement_status ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{personalMatchId}, #{accountNumber}, #{bankName}, #{amount}, #{settlementStatus} )
mapper.select:
select u.bank_name,u.account_number,pm.personal_match_id, date_format(pm.match_date,'%Y.%m.%d') as match_date_fmt, elt(dayofweek(pm.match_date),'일','월','화','수','목','금','토') as match_day, date_format(pm.start_time,'%H:%i') as start_time_fmt, pm.title,pm.sport,pm.region,pm.place_name,pm.status as match_status, pm.participation_fee,pm.fee,count(pmp.user_id) as participant_count, ps.settlement_status,date_format(ps.settled_at,'%c/%d') as settled_fmt from personal_match pm join user u on (u.user_id=pm.user_id) left join personal_match_participant pmp on (pmp.personal_match_id=pm.personal_match_id) and pmp.status = '결제완료' left join personal_settlement ps on (ps.personal_match_id=pm.personal_match_id) where pm.user_id=#{userId} and pm.status='경기 종료' and pm.match_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate} and exists (select 1 from personal_match_participant p2 where p2.personal_match_id = pm.personal_match_id and p2.status = '결제완료')
and pm.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
and ps.settlement_status = #{settlementStatus}
group by pm.personal_match_id,u.bank_name,u.account_number,pm.match_date,pm.start_time, pm.title,pm.sport,pm.region,pm.place_name,pm.status,pm.participation_fee, pm.fee,ps.settlement_status,ps.settled_at order by pm.match_date DESC, pm.start_time DESC limit #{row}, 10

select ifnull(sum(case when ps.settlement_status='정산대기' then ps.amount end),0) as wait_amount, ifnull(sum(case when ps.settlement_status='지급완료' and year(ps.settled_at)=year(curdate()) and month(ps.settled_at)=month(curdate()) then ps.amount end),0) as month_done_amount, ifnull(sum(case when ps.settlement_status='지급완료' then ps.amount end),0) as total_done_amount, month(curdate()) as cur_month from personal_settlement ps join personal_match pm on (pm.personal_match_id = ps.personal_match_id) where ps.user_id = #{userId} and pm.status = '경기 종료' and exists (select 1 from personal_match_participant p2 where p2.personal_match_id = pm.personal_match_id and p2.status = '결제완료')

select count(*) as all_cnt, count(case when ps.settlement_status='정산대기' then 1 end) as wait_cnt, count(case when ps.settlement_status='지급완료' then 1 end) as done_cnt from personal_match pm left join personal_settlement ps on ps.personal_match_id = pm.personal_match_id where pm.user_id=#{userId} and pm.status='경기 종료' and pm.match_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate} and exists (select 1 from personal_match_participant p2 where p2.personal_match_id = pm.personal_match_id and p2.status = '결제완료')
and pm.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
